description: This file defines the Prometheus Summary metric type, including interfaces, options, constructors, and internal implementations for collecting, summarizing, and exporting summary metrics with support for quantiles, buffering, and concurrency.

classes.name: Summary
classes.description: Interface for Prometheus summary metrics, supporting observation and collection.

classes.name: SummaryOpts
classes.description: Configuration options for creating a Summary metric, including namespace, name, help, labels, objectives, max age, and buffer capacity.

classes.name: SummaryVecOpts
classes.description: Options for creating a vector of Summary metrics partitioned by labels.

classes.name: summary
classes.description: Implementation of the Summary interface, managing internal buffers, quantile streams, and concurrency control.

classes.name: noObjectivesSummary
classes.description: Lock-free implementation of Summary without objectives, using atomic operations for concurrency.

classes.name: constSummary
classes.description: Immutable Summary with fixed count, sum, and quantiles, used for generated metrics.

methods.name: Observe
methods.description: Adds a single observation to the summary, buffering it for later aggregation.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Exports the current state of the summary as a protobuf metric.

methods.name: Desc
methods.description: Returns the descriptor of the metric.

methods.name: NewSummary
methods.description: Creates a new Summary instance based on provided options.

methods.name: newSummary
methods.description: Internal function to initialize a Summary with descriptor and options.

methods.name: swapBufs
methods.description: Swaps hot and cold buffers for observations, used during flushing.

methods.name: asyncFlush
methods.description: Triggers asynchronous flushing of buffered observations.

methods.name: maybeRotateStreams
methods.description: Rotates quantile streams based on expiration times.

methods.name: flushColdBuf
methods.description: Processes and incorporates cold buffer observations into quantile streams.

methods.name: newStream
methods.description: Creates a new quantile stream for objectives.
